description.en: Documented competence in endoscopic mucosal resection — injection, snare placement, and management of intraprocedural adverse events. Prerequisite to any ESD training.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for proficiency in emr (prerequisite) but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs proficiency in emr (prerequisite) independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches proficiency in emr (prerequisite) to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
